name: GOV base: RoleGranted
description: OpenZeppelin AccessControl (+Enumerable, ACLManager, TimelockController): RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity high. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
